title: Consolidate Semio Py Files Into Main Py
description: Consolidate semio.py, semio.test.py, and semio.benchmark.py into a single main.py file in semio/py/. Update all references.
summary: Consolidated semio.py, semio.test.py, and semio.benchmark.py into a single main.py file. Added missing imports (struct, time, pytest) to the top-level imports. Deduplicated helper functions with _test_ prefixes to avoid name collisions. Renamed test-specific TOLERANCE to TEST_TOLERANCE and ASSETS_DIR to TEST_ASSETS_DIR. Updated pyproject.toml hatch build includes and pytest config. Updated conftest.py to import main instead of semio. Updated engine.py sys.path and import from main. All 24 tests pass.
